definitions.content: identifiable part of a measuring instrument or of a family of measuring instruments that performs a specific function or functions, and that can be separately evaluated according to the prescribed metrological and technical performance requirements in the relevant Recommendation

notes.content: The modules of a weighing instrument may be subject to specified partial error limits.
Modules may be examined separately (subject to agreement with the metrological authority (see 6.2.6).
Typical modules of an automatic weighing instrument are: load cell (force receptor), indicator, analogue or digital processors, weighing module, remote display, software.
